description_en: Adds resource metadata. A resource is similar to a file and can have multiple attributes
description_zh: 资源相当于文件的概念，一个资源下可以有多个属性
kebab_example: aliyun sofa add-ms-config-resources --app-name foo --attributes attribute_name_:_attName_,_desc_:_some_attribute_comment_,_... --desc '测试资源类' --instance-id abcdEFGH1234 --biz-region Alipay --resource-id com.alipay.test.resource --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddMsConfigResources

parameters.help_en: The attribute information of the resource, passed in as a JSON string
parameters.help_zh: 资源的属性信息，以 JSON 字符串格式传入
parameters.name: attributes

parameters.help_en: The environment instance ID. This is a system field
parameters.help_zh: 系统字段：环境实例 ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The domain to which the resource type belongs
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en: The resource ID, similar to the file name of a configuration file
parameters.help_zh: 资源 ID，类似于配置文件的文件名
parameters.name: resource_id
